portraits.redistributionGrant: Publisher's Kaggle Dataset JSON-LD declares CC0: Public Domain, linked to CC0 1.0 Universal. Images retain CC0; repository code MIT does not replace it.
portraits.processing: Full square 1024×1024 image resized with Pillow LANCZOS to RGB 512×512 JPEG, quality 92, subsampling 0, optimize true; no retouch, face generation, crop, EXIF or source metadata copied.
portraits.reviewedBy: T6 author visual curation (AI-assisted; not an independent legal opinion)
portraits.visualCriteria: Adult-presenting, single photorealistic face, neutral conventional headshot framing; no child-like, fantasy, nonhuman, costume/uniform or obvious low-quality candidate selected. No identity or sensitive traits inferred.
portraits.assignment: Fictional casting only, in existing persona order; no inference about a real identity, ethnicity, religion, health or other sensitive trait.
